verifiedInvariants.contentAddressedWrite: the external Workspace revision is immutable and represented by one revision/hash identity across every recovery attempt
verifiedInvariants.transactionRollback: a crash after the Workspace event append and before PostgreSQL commit rolls back revision, ToolCall, effect, inbox, attempt, continuation and event facts together
verifiedInvariants.uncertaintyBoundary: an expired publisher is converted to outcome_unknown instead of blindly writing the external revision again
verifiedInvariants.reconciliation: observed external revision evidence confirms the Workspace revision and its effect ledger atomically
verifiedInvariants.noDuplicateFacts: retries create neither a duplicate external write nor a duplicate WorkspaceRevisionCommitted fact
